variables.name: title
variables.description: Task title or task id when title is unset. Substituted verbatim into the announcement.

variables.name: verb
variables.description: Past-tense verb phrase matching the task's terminal state — 'finished' for completed, 'failed' for failed, 'was cancelled' for cancelled. The orchestrator picks this per status so the voice model speaks naturally.

variables.name: summary_suffix
variables.description: Optional trailing summary, pre-formatted with a leading space (e.g. ' Sent to the team.'). Empty string when no summary is available — the announcement gracefully degrades to just the title + verb.

metadata.description: Short system message injected into the realtime voice session whenever a backend task this call dispatched reaches a terminal state. The voice model reads the rendered text aloud as a notification.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial release. Three variables; provider-neutral.
